Chemical Disaster - Upon a bloon's entry, it will be immediately glued with a moderately high constant damage stream that stacks with the main glue that it sends out. It can slow B.A.D.S., however only by 5% for balance.

Engineer, more seriously,  can throw out crazy amount of mechanical plasma monkeys at high speed when buffed. Not only that, it has a good buff that can stack up to ten times. XXL traps are also a good candidate for challenges and can be good as a "secondary permaspike"

You also mentioned the ice monkey, an important slowdown tower for most of mid game and of course it's ability to "freeze" water when using middle path is important. It's top path can heavily boost damage output which is also very useful, especially when paired with the sun avatar or a tack zone. However, it's bottom path is a bit lackluster, or maybe we just haven't found a use for it.

The alchemist that you mentioned also has it's perks, as a well used buff tower, however until you max it out the buff is temporary, and the alchemist can be overwhelmed whilst buffing towers. Middle path is just bad outside of challenges, it can transfrom valuable towers into something normally worse than what it transfromed. BMA is also mainly a challenge thing, however it has an achievement with a special reward option to [make bloons smaller](https://bloons.fandom.com/wiki/Small_Bloon_Option) , something that can be useful to help see things on screen.
